annotations.title: Post it on other networks too

description: Post a video they posted on Instagram outside the app on their other networks too: the app copies the file from Instagram, makes the post with the same caption at each account's next free posting time, and sends it for approval once the file is in (usually seconds; until then it's a draft). Use an id from insights_get posts or setup_run's suggestion (action kind copy). A post made in the app is duplicated instead (post_duplicate). Nothing publishes until a person approves it.

account_ids.description: Default: the connected TikTok, YouTube and Facebook accounts that haven't had it

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
